notes: mx-start-35: Owner decision 2026-10-22 ("nic nevyplňovat dvakrát"). The check itself still runs, but the default differs: in v2 the boxes can already be ticked on a second visit to the same bike, so the customer may proceed without seeing them again. mx-order-15: In v2, coming back to the SAME bike within the same account keeps the already ticked VOP/GDPR/guardian boxes from the abandoned draft; the old look always started with unticked boxes. Different bike = reset (booking_carry_v2.dart:50-80). This is the documented owner decision "nic nevyplňovat dvakrát" (2026-10-22), but it is weaker than the old guard.
